jobs.objective: REVISE the v3 RFC 0167 P0 implementation SPEC to resolve the two v3 residual constraints C2-prime-prime and C1-prime-prime per the v4 SEED's prescribed fixes, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything cleared through v1+v2+v3, and produce a CONSOLIDATED whole-P0 SPEC (not just deltas). Start from the v3 HOLDER.md (a required context doc); the v3 cycle-1 ledger (also required) has the C1-prime-prime and C2-prime-prime findings. Read the v4 SEED in full — it prescribes the exact fixes including a deeper composed read-scope route the v3 falsifier did not name. DISCHARGE C2-prime-prime (composed read-scope, THE decisive blocker): striatumd_rw must NOT be able to reconstruct client_id->principal_id by ANY route over the ACL graph. Close BOTH routes: Route 1 = client_capabilities cc JOIN operator_handles oh ON oh.leased_session_id=cc.session_id reading oh.principal_id; Route 2 (deeper) = cc JOIN oh JOIN runs r ON r.created_by_handle_id=oh.handle_id reading r.created_by_principal_id. Fix per SEED: (a) column-scope operator_handles SELECT to the runtime EXCLUDING principal_id (keep handle_id, leased_session_id, handle, repository_id, released_at, leased_until, last_heartbeat_at); (b) column-revoke runs.created_by_principal_id SELECT from striatumd_rw (REVOKE SELECT ON runs FROM striatumd_rw; GRANT SELECT on every other runs column enumerated; KEEP INSERT for the stamp; the BEFORE UPDATE trigger reads OLD and NEW row vars so is unaffected); (c) route whose, status --mine, and doctor-attribution identity reads through SECURITY DEFINER projections (owned by owner, EXECUTE to striatumd_rw, mirroring resolve_principal_for_client). Add a NEGATIVE control over the COMPOSED graph (both Route 1 and Route 2 as striatumd_rw must fail 42501 / return zero identity rows) and a POSITIVE control (projection-routed whose and status --mine + the stamp + lease heartbeat and close still work). Enumerate every reader of created_by_principal_id to prove the column-revoke breaks no other daemon path. DISCHARGE C1-prime-prime (operator-admin token scope): per SEED, resolve as JUSTIFIED-ACCEPTANCE — the operator-session token legitimately carries the operator's admin authority (a real operator drives checkpoint.resolve, review.override, decision.record, branch.confirm — a run-lifecycle-only capability would break the operator's job); provide the N-tokens blast-radius analysis (each token TTL-bounded and revoked on close = strictly-less-standing than the static 0600 admin token the human already holds); CONFIRM the existing verifier.attest IsSessionBound() refusal (verifier_attest.go:49-59) still fences the trust-root route from the session-bound operator token, and enumerate any other session-bound-refusing route, so the accepted surface is the operator's authority MINUS the already-fenced trust-root routes; add the control. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED: R1a, the R1b architecture, the v2 operator_sessions storage substrate + projection stamp, the v3 mintOperatorSessionToken authorization core + operator_sessions direct-read closure, R1c, the R2 write-once trigger + bundle ordinal 0021, R3's four open questions, R4 reuse. NOTE for the build run: owner bundle ordinal is 0021 at design time, but verify the next-free ordinal at build time (concurrent RFC 0142 P4 build may take 0021 first -> 0022). Open the SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v3 constraints' map. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
jobs.title: Hold revised P0 SPEC (v4 consolidated)

jobs.objective: Read the published REVISED (v4) holder SPEC, the v3 HOLDER.md, and the v3 cycle-1 ledger (C2-prime-prime). Your lens is C2-prime-prime / COMPOSED READ-SCOPE. Reason over the FULL ACL graph: can striatumd_rw recover client_id->principal_id by Route 1 (client_capabilities cc JOIN operator_handles oh on leased_session_id reading oh.principal_id), Route 2 (cc JOIN oh JOIN runs reading r.created_by_principal_id), or ANY THIRD route — another table, view, or function exposing principal_id to the runtime (check principals, principal_clients, operator_sessions, operator_handles, runs, and any new projection's underlying grant)? Verify the fix actually closes both: is operator_handles SELECT column-scoped to exclude principal_id? Is runs.created_by_principal_id SELECT revoked from striatumd_rw (and is the re-GRANT of the other runs columns complete — does it accidentally omit a column the daemon needs, or accidentally include created_by_principal_id)? Are the identity reads (whose, status --mine, doctor) routed through SECURITY DEFINER projections whose own grants don't re-leak? Are the NEGATIVE controls the actual COMPOSED queries (both routes), and do they truly fail 42501 / return no identity rows? Does the POSITIVE control prove whose and status/stamp/heartbeat still work? Does the runs column-revoke break any other daemon read path (find a SELECT * or a created_by_principal_id reader the holder missed)? If client_id->principal_id is reconstructable by any route, if a control is fake, or if the column-revoke breaks a real read path, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1 (C2'' / composed read-scope lens)

jobs.objective: Read the published REVISED (v4) holder SPEC, the v3 HOLDER.md, and the v3 cycle-1 ledger (C1-prime-prime). Your lens is C1-prime-prime / TOKEN-SCOPE + CARRY-FORWARD REGRESSION. Is there any genuinely-dangerous-when-session-bound admin route that does NOT already refuse session-bound tokens and is NOT addressed? THEN verify NO carry-forward regressed: R1a honesty, the R1b architecture (per-session created_by_handle_id + live-unique index + escalation walk), the v2 operator_sessions storage substrate (auth_pg.go:104-156) + projection stamp (no direct principal_clients.principal_id read), the v3 mintOperatorSessionToken authorization core (lane slice {claim,write,read,review} untouched, lane tokens still no admin) + operator_sessions direct-read closure, R1c guarded-UPDATE flap, the R2 BEFORE UPDATE write-once trigger + owner bundle ordinal 0021, R3's four open questions, R4 reuse. If the acceptance is not sound, the trust-root route is not fenced, or any carry-forward regressed, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 2 (C1'' / token-scope + carry-forward lens)

jobs.objective: Read only the dialogue trajectory for the RFC 0167 P0 v4 REVISION (the revised HOLDER.md and the two FALSIFIER.md challenges), with the v3 HOLDER.md and v3 cycle-1 ledger as context. Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (accept, accept_with_findings, needs_revision, or reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings). This is the intended CONVERGING cycle. A clearing verdict REQUIRES: C2-prime-prime DISCHARGED — striatumd_rw cannot reconstruct client_id->principal_id by Route 1, Route 2, or any third route (operator_handles principal_id column-scoped out; runs.created_by_principal_id SELECT revoked from the runtime; identity reads via SECURITY DEFINER projections that do not re-leak), proven by the COMPOSED negative controls + a positive control; AND C1-prime-prime DISCHARGED — a sound justified-acceptance of the operator-admin token with the verifier.attest trust-root refusal confirmed; AND no carry-forward regressed. The decisive, non-negotiable bar is C2-prime-prime: a still-reconstructable client_id->principal_id mapping (any route) is needs_revision. PREFER accept_with_findings for a MINOR residual (a noted build-time refinement) rather than needs_revision, reserving needs_revision for a materially unclosed identity leak, a broken proof, or a regressed carry-forward — the build run needs a cleared consolidated SPEC. Record per constraint C2-prime-prime and C1-prime-prime whether RESOLVED, per carry-forward whether INTACT, per new challenge whether it stands. This is the single allowed v4 revision cycle; a second needs_revision ends the gate unCleared and routes to the operator.
